tools.name: list_keepnet_products
tools.description: List Keepnet's products with a short description and page URL. Read-only; does not navigate.

tools.name: open_product_page
tools.description: Open a Keepnet product page in the current browser tab. Use list_keepnet_products to see valid values.

tools.name: request_keepnet_demo
tools.description: Open the Keepnet demo request page so the user can book a private demo. Does not submit any form automatically.

tools.name: search_keepnet_resources
tools.description: Search Keepnet's blog and resources (articles, guides, statistics). Navigates the current browser tab to the search results.
